system: G1-Warrant Deterministic Autonomous Remediation, Containment & Attestation Control Plane

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.mechanism: internal/warrant/engine.go + internal/server/api.go Scoped Auditor Bearer Isolation
controls.narrative: Every autonomous rollout, Cilium containment bridge, and exception resolution is gated by cryptographic Standing Warrant verification (fail-closed on missing, expired, or out-of-scope warrants). External auditor bearer tokens (g1aud_*) are strictly isolated to /api/v1/auditor/* and return HTTP 403 on all operational endpoints.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.mechanism: cmd/warrant-extractor + k8s/network-policy.yaml (Zero-Egress Content vs. Artifact Separation)
controls.narrative: Untrusted external prose (SARIF 2.1.0, CISA KEV feeds, Google OSV.dev advisories, CycloneDX VEX) is routed exclusively through the zero-privilege warrant-extractor service deployed on an isolated zero-egress network segment, emitting only regex-validated typed records.

controls.title: Separation of Duties
controls.mechanism: policies/warrant_ac5.rego + internal/crypto/dsse.go (2-of-2 Dual-Key Separation of Duties)
controls.narrative: Standing Warrants and Ceiling Exceptions require 2-of-2 cryptographic signatures over RFC 8785 JCS canonicalized DSSEv1 PAE bytes from two distinct human principals holding disjoint institutional roles: Slot 1 SERVICE_OWNER and Slot 2 AUTHORIZING_OFFICIAL. Self-co-signing and role collisions are deterministically rejected.

controls.title: Audit Events
controls.narrative: All Standing Warrant issuances, short-lived Task Warrant delegations (TTL <= 300s), extractor sanitizations, progressive canary transitions, containment bridges, and POA&M closures generate structured, timestamped cryptographic audit records with SHA-256 input/output lineage.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.mechanism: db/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql PostgreSQL WORM Triggers + SHA-256 Hash Chains
controls.narrative: PostgreSQL BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers enforce strict append-only immutability on standing_warrants, agent_action_ledger, and oscal_attestations, raising IMMUTABLE_LEDGER_VIOLATION on any mutation attempt while chaining prev_hash -> entry_hash across all rows.

controls.title: Non-repudiation
controls.narrative: Warrants, ceiling exceptions, and NIST OSCAL 1.1.2 closure attestations are sealed inside DSSEv1 envelopes signed via Ed25519 or W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators over RFC 8785 JCS payloads, enabling offline and in-browser non-repudiation verification.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.mechanism: internal/server/orchestrator.go Continuous Drift Sweeper + Live CISA KEV / OSV Poller
controls.narrative: Background control-plane reconciliation continuously polls running workload image digests and Cilium NetworkPolicy attachment states against attested closures, raising DRIFT_REOPENED alerts upon tampering and optionally syncing live CISA KEV and OSV.dev threat catalogs.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.mechanism: policies/gate_eligibility.rego + N2 Estate Autonomous Eligibility Scorecard
controls.narrative: Workloads must satisfy baseline readiness gates (>= 80% automated test coverage, OpenTelemetry probes, read-only shadow replica binding, and verified < 60s rollback automation) before qualifying for autonomous progressive rollout.

controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.narrative: Enforces stateless patch checks (zero DDL or ORM mutations) and compares baseline vs. canary JCS-normalized schemas, p50/p95/p99 latency ceilings, and Linux syscall capability sets, triggering instant rollback to baseline digest on any regression.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (organizational Users)
controls.mechanism: internal/crypto/webauthn.go Native W3C WebAuthn PIV/FIDO2 Verification
controls.narrative: Authenticates organizational authorizing officials and service owners via native W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators (RPID hash check, User Present & User Verified flags, ECDSA P-256 / Ed25519 verification) and live principal revocation checks.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (non-organizational Users)
controls.narrative: External scanner and remediation workers operate solely as governed delegates under Ed25519-signed ephemeral Task Warrants (max TTL 300s) bound to an active human-co-signed Standing Warrant and explicit target asset scope.

controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.narrative: Ingests SARIF 2.1.0, CycloneDX/VEX, CISA KEV, and Google OSV.dev advisories for race-triage prioritization, and requires deterministic HTTP exploit-replay rejection plus full pod digest verification before closing any vulnerability.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.mechanism: internal/adapters/cilium_shield.go OpenC2 / Cilium eBPF Containment & Runtime Lockout
controls.narrative: Deploys immediate virtual containment shields within SLA windows for unpatched or above-ceiling vulnerabilities and enforces permanent post-patch runtime network/process lockout policies verified by active canary probes.

controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.mechanism: policies/verify_closure.rego + internal/ledger/engine.go SHA-256 Digest & Chain Verification
controls.narrative: Verifies container image SHA-256 digests across every replica in the target fleet and validates unbroken genesis-to-head cryptographic hash chains across all three PostgreSQL WORM ledgers.
